thesis: Learning from examples replaces explicit rules only when honest examples and honest tests support generalization.
role: Establish data, supervision, unsupervised structure and sealed evaluation as the recurring foundation.

ideas.statement: Features, labels and a human-chosen loss determine what supervised learning can learn, including errors in the labels.
Clustering and dimensionality reduction find candidate structure, but distance, scaling and human interpretation determine its significance.
Training fits parameters, validation chooses hyperparameters and the sealed test estimates performance on new cases; time-dependent data requires chronological testing.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A white plate can become a shortcut for good cake; Friday labels can teach workplace habits rather than defects.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Known, stable exact rules remain better served by ordinary programs.

audit.notes: Entire assigned segment reviewed; scope and qualifications preserved. Duplicate contents and publication metadata are not ranked as ideas.
